sentences.text: Rup Rupa Verma & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 09 Appellate Side
Ct 32 Crr 2815 of 2024

rup Rupa Verma & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Chandra Gupta Kamal ... for the petitioners.

1 . 
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding in connection with C.G.R. Case No. 3387 of 2021, corresponding to New Alipore Police Station Case No. 203 of 2021 dated 18.11.2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act presently pending before the Court of Learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Alipore, South 24 Parganas.

entities.label: ORG

entities.text:
Court of Learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Alipore, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that opposite party No. 2 got married with the brother of the petitioner 18 years back.
The complaint with few omnibus allegations of torture was lodged for the first time after 18 yeas of marriage.
Ultimately, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that both the petitioners are sister-in-law of the complainant/opposite party no.2 herein and they are married.

3. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as well as having gone through the documents annexed herewith, particularly the written complaint lodged before the Officer-in-Charge of jurisdictional police station, I am inclined to admit the revisional application.

4. Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has also prayed for interim stay of the proceeding involved in this revisional application, otherwise the very purpose of filing of this revisional application shall stand frustrated.

6. Considering all facts and circumstances mentioned hereinabove, let the proceeding in connection with C.G.R. Case No. 3387 of 2021, corresponding to New Alipore Police Station Case No. 203 of Rup Rupa Verma & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171885934/
1 2021 dated 18.11.2021 be stayed for a limited period i.e till 29 th of November, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.
